media.title: Journey to America — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's journey to America and early U.S. immigration record. Includes the Certificate of Arrival no. 23-46078, Declaration of Intention no. 74224, Border-crossing manifest from Calexico, and related contextual images.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s journey to America, combining immigration and travel documents.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of immigration and travel documents relating to Bronisław Kaper’s journey to America, including arrival, declaration of intention and border-crossing records.
media.rightsNote: Rights are stated on each item in this gallery, not on the gallery as a whole. It gathers documents under different terms: some are public domain or served under the reuse terms of the holding institution, and 1 are reproduced at reduced resolution with rights uncleared. Follow the item to read its own statement.
media.publicCreditLine: Credits are given on each item. The gallery gathers material from the National Archives and Records Administration, the Pomona Public Library Frasher Foto Postcard Collection via Calisphere, Gallica of the Bibliothèque nationale de France and the Los Angeles Times Photographic Collection at UCLA Library Special Collections.

places.authorizedName: Calexico–Mexicali Port of Entry (Calexico, California / Mexicali, Baja California)
places.publicNote: Land border port of entry linking Calexico (California) and Mexicali (Baja California), documented as the point of Kaper and Eleonora's 1935 permanent-residence entry into the United States. The coordinates mark the historic downtown crossing at the foot of Heffernan Avenue, where the 1933 inspection station stood in 1935; the vehicle crossing was moved two blocks west in 1974 and the present buildings are later.
